subject: HANDOFF: Fold7 continuity display-state renderability qualification
body: WORKSTREAM_STATE=HANDOFF_READY. MESSAGE_TYPE=handoff. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. FINAL_MAIN_SHA=f925daab6526371af0c0cf8425a4647a02af95c7. BASELINE_DRIFT=YES, but overlapping runtime blobs are unchanged: Fold7ContinuityCoordinator=89946633e5a796b9fb63a85e392455170ba31d6f at both SHAs; Fold7CoverReadiness=f3c0db5ed3b061930a769d7085f4af59de0bc6ab at both; DuoShellService=c0d1bfedc602307f148538915cffc8cef860a2a2 at both. FINAL_FINDING=current app readiness conflates topology presence with renderability: isActive accepts every state except OFF/UNKNOWN, including DOZE_SUSPEND and ON_SUSPEND where Android explicitly says the CPU is not updating the display. Shell routeReady does not independently prove app-visible STATE_ON. Deterministic exhaustive model shows current readiness admits 25/49 state pairs and can advance COVER_PREWARMING -> COVER_READY_HIDDEN with cover=ON_SUSPEND/DOZE_SUSPEND; strict Fold7 STATE_ON readiness admits only ON/ON. TESTS=14/14 PASS plus exhaustive model PASS. RECOMMENDATION=do not globally change controller isActive; derive a separate readiness/renderability topology from the same DisplaySnapshot, require STATE_ON for Fold7 readiness, and log exact display states. Gen3 Alpha1 V3 support commit does not modify these runtime blobs, and apply_gen3_alpha1_v2 has no display-state qualification patch, so primary should recheck after any workflow-generated app commit and then integrate/retest if still applicable. PRODUCTION_WRITES=NONE. REQUIRES_PRIMARY_VERIFICATION=YES.
